name: Two-Weapon Style
body:
Feat Selection

The two-weapon fighting dragoon style’s feat selection are as follows: two-weapon fighting, improved two-weapon fighting, greater two-weapon fighting, double slice, two-weapon rend, and two-weapon defense.

Dragoon Style

At 2nd level, the dragoon learns to attack with two weapons, even when charging. On a charge, they attack with their main hand and off-hand together at an additional -2 penalty.

Improved Dragoon Style

At 6th level, the dragoon no longer takes the additional penalty from dragoon style, and they gain a morale bonus on damage rolls on their off-hand weapon attacks equal to their Charisma modifier (minimum of +0).

Greater Dragoon Style

At 11th level, after making an attack where they are two-weapon fighting the dragoon adds their Charisma modifier as a dodge bonus to AC until the beginning of their next turn.

Master Dragoon Style

At 17th level, the dragoon can make a full-round attack when charging and two-weapon fighting at the same time, using all of their iterative attacks and two-weapon fighting bonus attacks with their off-hand.
